about_blocks.text: Welcome to Red Road Recovery – a premier addiction treatment center located in Sorrento, British Columbia, Canada. At Red Road Recovery, we are dedicated to providing comprehensive and compassionate care to individuals struggling with addiction and co-occurring disorders.
about_blocks.html: Welcome to Red Road Recovery – a premier addiction treatment center located in Sorrento, British Columbia, Canada. At Red Road Recovery, we are dedicated to providing comprehensive and compassionate care to individuals struggling with addiction and co-occurring disorders.

about_blocks.text: Our approach to treatment is unique, as we blend evidence-based therapy with traditional indigenous healing practices. We believe that healing must address the whole person – mind, body, and spirit – and strive to create an environment that nurtures all aspects of our clients’ well-being.

about_blocks.text: Our team of experienced professionals is committed to helping our clients achieve lasting recovery and reclaim their lives. about_blocks.text: Red Road Recovery provides a serene and secure environment for those seeking to overcome drug and alcohol addiction and co-occurring disorders. With a focus on holistic healing, they blend conventional treatment techniques with indigenous healing practices to promote the restoration of the mind, body, and spirit. Collaborating with the local indigenous people, Red Road incorporates medicine wheel teachings and sweat lodge ceremonies to enhance the therapeutic benefits of nature.

about_blocks.text: Personalized Treatment Red Road Recovery creates individualized treatment plans to address the specific needs of each client using the bio-psycho-social model. They integrate evidence-based therapies like talk therapy, narrative therapy, and creative therapies with the 12-Step philosophy. Their comprehensive approach includes 30, 60, and 90-day residential treatment options, as well as outpatient treatment, virtual care, family counseling, and aftercare services. Each program emphasizes the overall health of the client through nutritional meals, fitness and exercise, massage, relaxation therapy, yoga, and more.

about_blocks.text: Idyllic Location Nestled on a hillside overlooking Shuswap lake and the surrounding mountains, Red Road Recovery’s facility offers a breathtaking location for healing and reflection. Private rooms with scenic views, ensuite bathrooms, a spacious outdoor deck area, and large common areas provide luxurious amenities to clients. Red Road Recovery’s holistic program, combined with the stunning setting, makes it an ideal choice for those seeking to treat addiction and co-occurring disorders simultaneously.
